Third-party files (unmodified builds):
- pdf.min.js, pdf.worker.min.js: pdf.js 3.11.174, Apache-2.0, https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
- leaflet.js, leaflet.css: Leaflet 1.9.4, BSD-2-Clause, https://leafletjs.com
- ../data/airports.json: airport names/coordinates derived from OurAirports (public domain), 2015 snapshot via the npm package airport-codes. Newer airports (e.g. ZUTF) are missing.
